description: This file defines the TrackerManager class, which manages tracker monitors within the SuiteCRM system. It implements singleton pattern, handles monitor configuration, enabling/disabling monitors, and provides methods for saving and managing monitor instances.

classes.name: TrackerManager
classes.description: Manages tracker monitors, implements singleton pattern, handles monitor configuration, enabling/disabling, and provides methods for saving and managing monitor instances.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor for singleton pattern, loads tracker configuration and initializes monitor ID.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Loads configuration settings and disables monitors based on admin settings.

methods.name: setMonitorId
methods.description: Sets the monitor ID and updates all monitor instances with the new ID.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of TrackerManager.

methods.name: getMonitor
methods.description: Retrieves a monitor instance by name, creating it if necessary, or returns a BlankMonitor if not found.

methods.name: _getMonitor
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate a monitor class based on name and metadata.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves all monitors, with special handling for session tracker.

methods.name: saveMonitor
methods.description: Saves a specific monitor instance and optionally clears it.

methods.name: unsetMonitor
methods.description: Removes a monitor instance from the manager.

methods.name: isPaused
methods.description: Checks if tracking is currently paused.

methods.name: getDisabledMonitors
methods.description: Returns list of disabled monitor names.

methods.name: setDisabledMonitors
methods.description: Sets the list of disabled monitors.
